Akshay Kumar Pays Tribute to Asrani, Shares Last Shot from 'Haiwaan'

Actor Akshay Kumar has shared an emotional tribute to veteran actor Asrani, recalling his experience of working with him on the upcoming film 'Haiwaan'. Kumar stated it was his good fortune to witness the legendary performer's last shot for the movie. The film 'Haiwaan' is set to feature Asrani's final screen appearance. Kumar shared a note expressing his admiration, stating there can be no one like Asrani.
